title: pattern design expands in 3d window
content:
![c1d87dff144444fda615bffe56bd1a96](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202602/812d685ab7284b86b57014cf2b90ec5d/images/c1d87dff144444fda615bffe56bd1a96image.png)hi,

Can anyone help on this my pattern design expands in 3d window while in 2d window it looks perfect.

Regards.

Nk

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: i got the answer , it is all about shrinkage weft.👍🏻

Comment 2: hard to tell from such a close up in 3D, but it just looks like the angle you are viewing it from and how the garment is draping
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to seek assistance from the community in resolving an issue with a pattern design that appears distorted in a 3D view while maintaining its integrity in a 2D view.
